'''2007 Massachusetts State Championship Mark Neumann LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Neumann]] at [[2007 Massachusetts State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mark A. N... (surname faint; possibly Neumann)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
